newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures dip on long-liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures dip on long-liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday, as sporadic long-liquidation in nearby months ahead of the spot expiry on Friday spilled over into other contracts, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen to 1.8 yen per kg lower. Benchmark March was down 0.8 yen at 134.5 yen.
Activity was subdued. Little bargain-hunting buying was detected as sentiment was fundamentally bearish.
"Market players were wary of taking fresh positions before the expiry. Traders could accept deliveries if the spot contract expires below 125 yen," one trader said.
